title: Epic Seven Steam Build Priorities — PvE, Guild War & World Arena
meta: Steam/transfer Epic Seven build priorities: what to build first for PvE, Guild War and World Arena, post-transfer resource limits, budget swaps, and FAQ. Not a full-roster tier list.
lead: This is a Steam/transfer investment guide, not a current full-roster tier list. Most tier lists answer “who is strongest on the full roster?” This page answers a narrower question: with a Steam/Foundry account — or a legacy account you just moved to Steam — which heroes should you actually build first for PvE, Guild War, and World Arena? The notes describe build order and role coverage for that account, not an absolute global ranking.
answer: Short answer: build one PvE core first (Angelic Montmorancy, Falconer Kluri, Commander Lorina, plus a farmer such as Alexa), then add one Guild War backbone (tank + revive/cleanse) and one World Arena opener (speed/CR or control). Transfer keeps your old progress but does not move a legacy Heir onto Foundry; Foundry GW and WA unlock on separate dates, so spend resources against those dates — not against every banner.
lens_note: This page describes build order and role coverage for a constrained Steam/transfer account. It does not assign letter grades, and it is not a full-roster ranking.

why_h2: Why this is not another global tier list
why_p1: Mode-specific public resources such as epic7db, gacha.gg, hideoutgacha and Epic Helper rank a full roster or an RTA pool for their own patch. They are useful when you own most heroes and want the best pick for that mode. They are less useful when your account is one week old, when your gear is a single Wyvern set, or when you have just converted a legacy login and cannot afford to rebuild a second roster on Foundry.
why_p2: This page is narrower: free or low-cost units you can actually obtain on a Steam/Foundry account, plus role examples for the slots your starter roster cannot fill. The notes describe the job each hero covers; they are not a letter grade or a claim that the hero is globally best. Verify kits, current patch data and mode-specific placement on the sources linked below.
why_p3: Resource constraint is the whole point. A transfer account keeps progress, purchases, and unclaimed rewards, but Foundry is a separate server track with its own characters and matchmaking. You do not get a second gear library, a second molagora stock, or automatic Foundry entry. That changes the answer from “build the best hero” to “build the smallest roster that clears the next gate.”
not_h2: What we deliberately do not do
not_p: We do not publish a 100-hero global ranking, letter grades, star ratings, or invented multipliers. We do not scrape or republish another site's table. We link out to mode-specific public references and keep the Steam/Foundry scenario notes original.
bands_intro: Read each band as an investment instruction for a constrained account, not as a verdict on the hero's absolute power. A hero can be A here and still be the best pick in a different roster.
bands_th: What it means for a Steam/transfer account
bands_note: Tier letters are this page's build bands. They are not official ratings, and they do not replace full-roster rankings or in-client testing.
constraints_intro: Transfer solves the login problem; it does not solve the resource problem. These are the constraints that change the build order.
constraints: One gear set, not two. Transfer keeps what is on your legacy heroes; it does not duplicate gear for Foundry. Move your best speed/effectiveness pieces to the hero you are actually fielding, not to the one with the highest tier badge.
Molagora is the real bottleneck. A 20-hero tier list is not a build plan. Skill up four to six heroes first; leave the rest at +0 until they have a fixed slot.
Gold and charms disappear faster than bookmarks. Do not reforge every drop. Pick a Wyvern team, farm one set, and stop when the main stats are usable.
Leifs are for buff windows, not for impatience. Foundry starter buffs and celebration mail run on their own timers; check STOVE before burning leifs on a day with no buff.
Bookmarks are a banner decision, not a tier decision. A hero being high on another site does not mean pull now. Check [[Banners|/banners/]] for the live pickup and confirm pity in-client.
Foundry is not a transfer destination. A converted legacy login stays on its server; Foundry GW/WA need a Foundry character. Budget separately if you play both.
Do not delete the in-game account after transfer to “clean up” the demo. The [[demo warning|/demo-delete-warning/]] exists because that action can remove original-server progress.

Dates beat tier lists. Foundry Guild War is introduced on 2026-11-19 (the official sentence gives no clock), Form Defense at 2026-11-21 11:00 Beijing time (03:00 UTC), and Matchmaking at 2026-11-23 11:00 Beijing time (03:00 UTC). World Arena opens after the 2026-12-10 maintenance (official Steam wording: KST; no clock time is posted). Build for the date you can actually field a team.
pve_intro: This is the “clear the next gate” list: story, Wyvern, and the first stable Hunt team. On a new Steam/Foundry account, free specialty-change units do most of the work; banner heroes are optional accelerators. If you already transferred a geared legacy account, you can skip most of this section and go straight to the Guild War and World Arena sections.
pve_note: PvE value here means reliability and low gear cost. A hero who clears with free speed gear is worth more to a new account than a premium hero who needs a full set you do not own.
gw_h2: Guild War role coverage (Foundry: introduced 2026-11-19; Form Defense 2026-11-21 11:00 Beijing time; Matchmaking 2026-11-23 11:00 Beijing time)
gw_answer: For Guild War, build a tank that can hold a tower, a revive/cleanse support, and one damage dealer you can field on both offense and defense. Do not build twelve Guild War heroes; build four that cover both sides.
gw_intro: Guild War rewards role coverage more than raw tier. A team that survives the first two turns and recycles a revive is usually more useful than a glass cannon that wins one attack and loses every defense. Foundry Guild War is introduced on 2026-11-19, with Form Defense at 2026-11-21 11:00 Beijing time (03:00 UTC) and Matchmaking at 2026-11-23 11:00 Beijing time (03:00 UTC), per the Steam Foundry Guild War notice. Re-check the live notice before planning guild resets.
gw_off_note: Offense wants a reliable opener, a defense-break or strip, and a damage dealer that does not need perfect gear. Speed tuning matters more than a high tier badge.
gw_def_note: Defense wants a tank, a cleanse/revive, and enough effect resistance to survive the first control wave. A defense team that stalls is doing its job even when it does not kill.
gw_prep: Confirm your character is on the right server. A legacy guild does not count as a Foundry Guild War roster.
Join or create a guild before the unlock date and make sure the request shows Accepted, not Pending.
Clear daily guild missions and donate within the cap; missed contribution days do not stack.
Set offense and defense teams the day membership is accepted, then re-check after every maintenance.
Use Foundry Draft Arena as practice: field a tank, a cleanser, and a healer you can also use on defense.
Do not spend leifs or guild currency on a hero who only works on one side of the war.
wa_h2: World Arena role coverage (Foundry: after 2026-12-10 maintenance, official Steam wording KST, no posted clock)
wa_answer: World Arena rewards draft coverage: speed/CR openers, control, and one or two counterpicks. For a constrained account, build one fast opener and one flexible damage dealer before chasing niche counters.
wa_intro: World Arena is not Guild War with a different button. You need a plan for turn order, cleanse, and the opponent's ban/pick. The heroes that carry a starter account are usually the ones that either start the turn chain or stop the opponent's chain — not the ones with the highest PvE damage.
wa_draft: Pick one speed opener first; without turn order, the rest of the draft is decoration.
Add a cleanse or immunity option so a single control unit does not end the match.
Keep one damage dealer flexible enough to punish a tank-heavy draft.
Do not draft three units that all need the same support; a banned support leaves you with no plan.
Check the live ban/pick rules in-client; they can differ from the previous season.
wa_counter: Anti-cleave: a barrier/cleanse support plus a unit that punishes the first AoE.
Anti-tank: a defense-break or HP-scaling damage dealer; raw attack alone stalls out.
Anti-control: immunity/cleanse plus effect resistance on the unit that must act.
Budget answer: reuse the PvE core with one speed set; do not build a separate World Arena roster from zero.
wa_note: Exact pick/ban rules and season rewards are client/official. This page only covers build order for a Steam/transfer account.
budget_h2: Budget swaps: who does the job cheaper
budget_intro: Before you chase a premium banner, check whether a free or already-owned unit covers the same job. A cheaper unit with the right speed can beat an ungeared premium hero.
budget: Specialty change; free, and still a real cleanse/heal slot.
Specialty change; opens Hunt and Guild War offense without premium gear.
Specialty change; long-term PvE damage that does not need a limited banner.
Common dual-attack farmer; pairs with Furious and a tank.
Ras is free and serviceable early; Fallen Cecilia is a straightforward tank upgrade if you already own her.
Defensive supports to use only if already owned — do not chase a banner for a defense slot you cannot gear.
Free CR tools early; replace with a premium opener when you have the gear.
Widely cited control picks; verify the current patch before investing.
plan_h2: A 14-day build plan for a transferred or new Steam account
plan_intro: Two weeks is enough to field one PvE team and one Guild War core if you stop spreading resources. Adjust to your actual play time; the order matters more than the calendar.
plan: Day 1: decide the account path. Keeping legacy progress? Convert STOVE→Steam before a fresh login. Starting Foundry? Accept that it is a separate roster. Read [[Steam transfer|/steam-transfer/]] and [[Foundry|/foundry/]] first.
Day 1–2: pick four heroes, not twelve. One farmer, one defense-break, one cleanse/heal, one damage dealer. Put your best speed gear on the opener.
Day 3–5: clear the first Wyvern tier with the free core. Do not reforge off-set gear; keep gold for the pieces you will actually wear.
Day 6–8: finish the specialty changes you selected. Do not start a fifth project because a banner looked good.
Day 9–10: build the Guild War defense core (tank + cleanse/revive). Test it in Draft Arena before Form Defense at 2026-11-21 11:00 Beijing time.
Day 11–12: set offense and defense, join a guild, and confirm Accepted status. Clear daily guild missions.

Day 13–14: start the World Arena opener. One speed set, one cleanse option, one flex damage dealer. Save the rest for World Arena after the 2026-12-10 maintenance (KST in the official Steam notice; no clock time is posted).
roster_h2: Hero cards on this page (on-site avatars)
roster_intro: These cards also appear on [[Heroes|/heroes/]], so the art and names stay on-site. The notes describe the role each hero can cover; this page does not put letter grades under the cards.

hero_notes.ras: Free knight and story anchor. Early tank for PvE and a serviceable Guild War body when you have no premium tank.
hero_notes.mercedes: Starter AoE mage. Fine for story clears; not a priority once a real farmer is online.
hero_notes.aither: Early healer. Move to Angelic Montmorancy or another cleanse support as soon as you can.
hero_notes.judith: Free CR pusher. A budget World Arena opener until you own a premium speed unit.
hero_notes.angelic-montmorancy: Free specialty-change cleanse/heal. The single best early support investment on a constrained account.
hero_notes.falconer-kluri: Specialty-change defense break and CR. Opens Hunt and Guild War offense without premium gear.
hero_notes.commander-lorina: Specialty-change single-target damage. Slow to build, but a long-term PvE answer that does not need a limited banner.
hero_notes.alexa: Wyvern farmer. Build her for one job, then stop; she is not a Guild War or World Arena pick.
hero_notes.furious: Defense break and target for Wyvern. A PvE enabler; keep him on the PvE side of the account.
hero_notes.silk: Free CR push. Useful while you lack a speed opener; replace rather than over-invest.
hero_notes.vildred: Earth cleave damage. Speeds story and some PvE farms; falls off in a serious World Arena draft.
hero_notes.luna: Foundry celebration path often highlights a limited Luna join around Rank 70 — confirm on STOVE. Strong PvE damage; not a universal GW/WA answer.
hero_notes.tamarinne: Heal, cleanse, and CR in one slot. The usual upgrade path from Aither or Montmorancy for players who own her.
hero_notes.fallen-cecilia: Dark knight built for Guild War defense. If you own her, she is usually the first tank you gear.
hero_notes.ruele-of-light: Revive/cleanse defensive support. A Guild War defense staple when paired with a real tank.
hero_notes.seaside-bellona: AoE debuff damage that works in PvE and both PvP modes. Flexible, but gear-hungry.
hero_notes.specter-tenebria: Single-target dark damage with debuff pressure. A Guild War/WA pick, not a starter farmer.
hero_notes.arbiter-vildred: Cleave/revive threat and a common World Arena opener. Expensive to gear; do not chase him before your PvE core.
hero_notes.politis: Anti-cleave and CR disruption. A World Arena answer to speed drafts; niche in PvE.
hero_notes.cerise: Control opener for World Arena. Strong when the draft lets her act first; verify the current patch.

beyond_h2: GW/WA role examples beyond the starter 12
beyond_intro: These are role examples for slots the starter roster does not fill. They are not a ranking. Verify kits and current mode placement on the mode sources linked from [[the tier-list resource page|/tier-list/]].
banners_h2: Banners: when a tier list should not make the decision
banners_p: A hero's role note on this page is not a pull recommendation. Banner timing, pity, and rates live in the client; schedule notes live on [[Banners|/banners/]]. If a pickup does not fill one of your four open slots, skip it. If you are on Foundry, remember that the Rank 70 Luna path and daily free Covenant summons are celebration rewards with their own window — not a reason to abandon your build plan. See [[Foundry|/foundry/]] for the calendar and [[FAQ|/faq/]] for transfer questions.
faqs: Is this a global Epic Seven tier list?

No. It describes build priority for Steam/Foundry and transferred accounts. For full-roster or mode-specific rankings, use the sources compared on [[the tier-list resource page|/tier-list/]]; we link out and do not republish their tables.
Does transferring my account move my heroes to Foundry?

No. Transfer keeps legacy progress, purchases, and unclaimed rewards, but Foundry is a separate server track with its own characters and matchmaking. A legacy Heir does not automatically join Foundry Guild War or World Arena.
Who should I build first on a new Steam account?
One PvE core: Angelic Montmorancy, Falconer Kluri, Commander Lorina, and a farmer such as Alexa. Add Furious if your Wyvern team needs defense break. Do not start twelve projects.

Role coverage: a tank, a cleanse/revive support, and one damage dealer you can field on both sides. Foundry GW is introduced on 2026-11-19, with Form Defense at 2026-11-21 11:00 Beijing time (03:00 UTC) and Matchmaking at 2026-11-23 11:00 Beijing time (03:00 UTC); confirm the live Steam/STOVE notice and guild membership.

Turn order and draft coverage: one speed/CR opener, one cleanse/immunity option, one flexible damage dealer, and one counterpick. Foundry WA is posted after the 2026-12-10 maintenance (official Steam wording: KST; no clock time is posted).
Can I use my legacy gear on Foundry?
Only what you actually move or re-farm. Transfer does not duplicate gear or molagora. Treat Foundry as a separate resource budget unless you only play the legacy character on Steam.
Should I pull a hero because this page lists them?
No. This page lists build order, not banner advice. Check the live pickup on /banners/, your pity count in-client, and whether the hero fills an open slot.
How often is this page updated?

The build-priority body copy was not rewritten in this batch. Official Guild War and World Arena dates were re-checked on 2026-11-13 against the Steam/STOVE source text; re-check the live notice after maintenance.
